best_idea: Keep the current victim until a challenger's threat is more than 110% of its threat; a challenger above 130% takes over at any range, and below 130% only a melee-range challenger takes over, so ranged attackers cannot pull a tank off target with a small lead.
decision_why: Keep the 110/130 switch and the melee rule for the engine hate table, but move re-selection from a 1000 ms timer to the fight tick, add the MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 cap and a seeded tie-break, which the donor lacks.
acceptance: In a 3-on-1 server test the top-threat attacker keeps the target at a 110% lead, a melee challenger at 115% takes over, a ranged challenger at 120% does not take over until 130%, and the same seed gives the same switch sequence.
